title: Claims Table
description: Structured acceptance criteria extracted from a design document. Produced by the claims-table skill.

component_name.description: Name of the component this design doc describes. Taken from the doc's H1.

doc_path.description: Path to the source design doc, relative to repo root.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this claims.json was generated.

doc_sha.description: Git SHA of the design doc at extraction time, if available.

summary.description: Aggregate counts. Computed; the user shouldn't edit by hand.

claims.description: Individual acceptance criteria. Order matches the source doc.

id.description: Stable identifier within this doc. Format: AC-<integer>.

claim.description: EARS-form claim text. One of the five canonical patterns plus their compositions.

ears_pattern.description: Which EARS pattern the claim matches. Computed from claim text.

verification_evidence.description: Optional pointer to evidence justifying the confidence (only meaningful for 'verified' or 'tested').

test_anchor.description: Pointer to the test verifying this claim. Format: 'path/to/test.ext::name' (pytest) or 'path/to/test.ext#name' (other). Use 'pending' if not yet written.

drift_anchor.description: Pointer to the code symbol this claim depends on. Format: 'path/to/file.ext#Symbol'. Use 'pending' if not yet implemented.

depends_on.description: Other claim IDs this claim depends on (e.g., a postcondition that assumes a precondition).

rationale.description: Free-text note explaining the claim's origin, edge cases, or any context that didn't fit in the EARS form.

owner.description: Optional owner (person or agent) responsible for verifying this claim.
